name: stash
description: Summarize a rough note into a structured card, then search and ask over that Stash notebook.

interface.longDescription:
Stash is a personal notebook. This plugin connects a Stash account over remote MCP.

Summarize saves a rough text note and the Stash server turns it into a structured card. Search finds notes by keyword. Ask answers a question from the signed-in user's notes only, with no web search.

Free accounts can search, read, and save notes within a monthly allowance. Ask needs Stash Pro. Sign in with the same Apple or Google account as the Stash app. Leave the OAuth client id and secret blank; Stash uses dynamic client registration.

Notes are encrypted at rest. Connecting an agent decrypts them on Stash servers so tools can run — the same decryption the server already uses to summarize a note. This is not zero-knowledge. Revoke the connector, or delete the Stash account, to stop access.

Setup and privacy: https://stash.graftedsoftware.com/agents
defaultPrompt: Search my Stash notes for the Hawaii trip.
Stash this: renew the car registration next month.
What did I save about flights?
